title: LOK SABHA SPEAKER PAYS FLORAL TRIBUTES TO MAULANA ABUL KALAM AZAD
body_text:
Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla paid floral tributes at the portrait of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan on his Birth Anniversary, today. Minister of Parliamentary Affairs and Minister of Minority Affairs, Govt. of India, Shri Kiren Rijiju; Members of Parliament and former Members also paid floral tributes at the portrait of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad on this occasion. Secretary-General, Lok Sabha, Shri Utpal Kumar Singh and Secretary - General, Rajya Sabha Shri P.C. Mody paid tributes to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad. A booklet containing the profile of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad, brought out in Hindi and English by the Lok Sabha Secretariat, was also presented to the dignitaries who attended the function. The portrait of Maulana Abul Kalam Azad was unveiled by the then President of India, Dr. Rajendra Prasad, in the Central Hall of Samvidhan Sadan (earlier Parliament House) on 16 December 1959. स्वाधीनता संग्राम के ओजस्वी सेनानी, महान शिक्षाविद् एवं स्वतंत्र भारत के प्रथम शिक्षा मंत्री ‘भारत रत्न’ मौलाना अबुल कलाम आज़ाद जी की जयंती पर शत्-शत् नमन।

आज संविधान सदन के केंद्रीय कक्ष में पुष्पांजलि अर्पित कर राष्ट्रनिर्माण, शिक्षा और सामाजिक समरसता के क्षेत्र में उनके अतुलनीय योगदान का स्मरण किया। उनके विचार और आदर्श सदैव राष्ट्र का मार्ग प्रशस्त करते रहेंगे। — Om Birla (@ombirlakota) November 11, 2026 * ** AM
